title: Read Parquet HDFS file using Pyspark
question:
I have a hive External Table created with

InputFormat org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.MapredParquetInputFormat and OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.MapredParquetOutputFormat

How do I read these hive table files from hdfs using PySpark?
answer:
Those are parquet files, just read it from the location of the table -

df = spark.read.parquet(<hdfs-location>)
